system.description:
During the [Damage Apply Step], you receive the expected HP damage that a target other than yourself would have received. The target receives no damage. You can only use this skill once in response to any given attack.

(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A special skill that blocks attacks from distant allies instead. You are prepared for unexpected attacks from a distance.
